High-level HTTP client facade for Supranim, built on powpow's internal HTTP client (HttpClient / AsyncHttpClient, re-exported from ./httpclient). Provides a simple fluent API for making requests: synchronous and asynchronous get / post (with HttpForm encoded as JSON), JSON deserialization via get[T], per-request headers (withHeaders), bearer tokens (withToken), and automatic retries with a configurable backoff (retry). Also includes the normalizePath utility used by the web server backends to collapse repeated slashes.

Sends an async POST request to the specified URI with a JSON-encoded form body and returns the response.

The form is serialized before entering the async state machine (an openArray cannot be captured by an async closure).
